sections.heading: Air, water, soil — sources and impacts (the technical register)

rows: **Air**
Stationary combustion (power ~half of SO2), vehicles (NOx-CO-PM), industry-processes, biomass-stubble, dust; **secondary formation** (SO2/NOx→sulphate-nitrate PM; VOC+NOx+sun→ozone)
PM2.5's alveolar-to-blood penetration (IHD, stroke, COPD, LBW); ozone's crop enzyme damage; SO2-NOx→acid deposition; black carbon's glacier forcing
**Water**
Sewage (BOD-pathogens), industry (metals-toxics: Cr-tanneries, Hg, Pb), agriculture (N-P runoff, pesticides), aquaculture effluents, thermal discharge

Oxygen sag below outfalls (DO crash → fish kill); **eutrophication-algal-hypoxia**; **biomagnification** of persistent toxics up food chains (Minamata's Hg lesson); pathogen disease burden; nitrate's blue-baby (methemoglobinemia)
**Soil**
Agrochemical residues (OC pesticides' persistence), heavy metals (sewage-irrigation, industrial fallout, mine tailings), plastic film, fly-ash, salinisation
Microbiome-earthworm decline → fertility loss; crop uptake → dietary metal exposure (Cd in rice); groundwater leaching; persistence (POPs' decades)

blocks.text: **Measurement literacy** (the science-paper differentiator): air — µg/m³, AQI's pollutant-wise sub-indices; water — **BOD** (organic load's oxygen demand; bathing-class <3 mg/l), **COD, DO, faecal coliform (MPN)**; soil — pH-EC-organic carbon plus contaminant assays; bio-indicators (lichens for air, mayflies for streams).

items: **Air control**: particulates — **ESPs** (electrostatic precipitators; the coal-plant standard), bag filters, cyclones-scrubbers; gases — **FGD** (flue-gas desulphurisation; the delayed 2015-norms saga), **SCR/low-NOx burners**, catalytic converters (BS-VI's three-way + DPF+SCR), VOC capture; process shifts — cleaner fuels (gas, ethanol), electrification; area measures — dust suppression, green buffers, stubble in-situ (Happy Seeder-decomposer).

**Water control**: the **treatment train** — primary (screens-settling) → **secondary biological** (activated sludge, trickling filters, UASB, SBR, the low-cost oxidation ponds-wetlands) → tertiary (nutrient removal, disinfection UV/Cl, membranes for reuse); **CETPs** for industrial clusters; **ZLD** for high-toxic sectors (textiles' Tirupur precedent); non-point control — buffer strips, fertiliser scheduling, drip; in-situ river rehab — aeration, wetland interception (the Ganga bioremediation pilots).

**Soil control & remediation**: prevention (balanced fertilisation, IPM, treated-only sewage irrigation) → containment (lining, capping) → remediation — **phytoremediation** (hyperaccumulators; vetiver-sunflower), **bioremediation** (microbial degraders; oil-zapper's fame), soil washing, electrokinetics, biochar amendment — the technology ladder by cost.

**The management wrap**: standards (NAAQS, effluent norms) + monitoring (CAAQMS, real-time effluent OCEMS) + enforcement (consent-to-operate, closures) + economics (ETS pilots, treated-water reuse markets) — technology works when institutions make it bind (the G-093 governance file complements).

sections.heading: 🔬 Deep mastery — the technical register of pollution & control

rows: **Air**
PM2.5/PM10, SO₂, NOₓ, CO, O₃, VOCs
ESP, bag filters, scrubbers (FGD), catalytic converters, cyclone separators
**Water**

**Soil**

items: **Standards & monitoring:** **NAAQS (CPCB)**, the **AQI** (6 categories), **NAMP** water-quality monitoring, and the **National Clean Air Programme (NCAP)** targeting a 40% PM cut in non-attainment cities by 2026.
**The engineering answer** always pairs **prevention (cleaner fuel/process) + capture (end-of-pipe) + treatment + safe disposal** — cite specific tech (FGD for SO₂, SCR for NOₓ) to score.

prelimsPointers: **AQI** — 6 categories (Good to Severe); pollutant with the worst sub-index sets the AQI.
**FGD (Flue-Gas Desulfurisation)** removes SO₂ from thermal-plant emissions.
**NCAP** target: 40% reduction in particulate pollution in non-attainment cities.
**BOD** — oxygen demanded by microbes degrading organic waste; bathing-quality benchmark **<3 mg/l**; DO healthy river ~5+ mg/l.
**Secondary pollutants**: ozone, sulphate-nitrate PM — formed in-air from precursors; ground-level ozone needs sun+NOx+VOC.
**ESP** removes particulates by charging-collection; **FGD** scrubs SO2 (limestone-gypsum); **SCR** reduces NOx with ammonia over catalyst.
**BS-VI (2020)** cut sulphur to 10 ppm enabling DPF-SCR after-treatment.
**UASB** — anaerobic sludge-blanket sewage tech; oxidation ponds & constructed wetlands the low-cost train.
**ZLD (zero liquid discharge)** mandated for highly polluting textile clusters (Tirupur precedent).
**Biomagnification** — concentration of persistent toxics up trophic levels (DDT, Hg — Minamata).
**Phytoremediation** uses hyperaccumulator plants; **bioremediation** microbial degraders (TERI's Oilzapper).

glossary.definition: Biochemical/Chemical oxygen demand — organic-pollution loads measured by the oxygen their degradation consumes.
Device charging flue-gas particles for plate collection — the workhorse of coal-plant PM control.
Scrubbing SO2 from stack gases (typically limestone slurry → gypsum) — the 2015 norms' delayed centrepiece.
Aerobic microbial treatment of sewage in aerated tanks with sludge recycling — secondary treatment's standard.
Full recovery-recycle of industrial effluent with only solid residue leaving — the high-toxics sector mandate.
Using plants to extract, stabilise or degrade soil-water contaminants — green, slow, cheap remediation.

blocks.text: Noise = unwanted sound; measured in **decibels (dB(A))** on a **logarithmic scale** (+10 dB = ×10 intensity, ~×2 loudness). Sources: traffic (the urban baseline), construction, industry, generators, aircraft, and India's specials — horns and loudspeakers-festivals. **Impacts**: auditory (NIHL — permanent >85-90 dB chronic exposure) and the larger non-auditory file — sleep disruption, cardiovascular stress (hypertension-IHD associations at >55 dB night), cognition (children's learning near flight paths), wildlife disruption (bird song shifts, marine mammals vs shipping sonar). **Regulation**: **Noise Rules 2000** under EPA — zone standards (**industrial 75/70, commercial 65/55, residential 55/45, silence 50/40 day/night dB**), silence zones (100 m around hospitals-schools-courts), loudspeaker curfews (10 pm-6 am; SC's *In Re Noise Pollution 2005*), CPCB's ambient-noise network in metros — enforcement the weak limb (police-SPCB split).

rows: Generation & composition
India MSW ~**62+ MT/yr (1.5 lakh+ TPD)**; typical mix ~50-55% wet/organic, ~30% dry recyclables, rest inert-domestic-hazardous; per-capita ~0.4-0.6 kg/day urban
**Rules architecture**

**SWM Rules 2016** (segregation at source into wet-dry-domestic hazardous; user fees; decentralised processing; landfill only for residuals) + the EPR family — **Plastic (2016/22), e-Waste (2022), Battery (2022), C&D (2016)** rules
Processing menu

**Composting-vermicomposting** (wet), **biomethanation/CBG** (GOBARdhan link), material-recovery facilities (dry), **waste-to-energy** (calorific caveats — Indian waste's low CV; Okhla-era controversies), C&D recycling plants, **sanitary landfill vs the dumpsite legacy (~3,000+ sites; SBM 2.0's remediation of ~15-16 crore tonnes)**
Recycle-reuse economy

India's recycling tradition (kabadiwala's ~60% paper-plastic-metal informal recovery); **EPR credits marketplaces**; refill-reuse models; the **informal-sector integration imperative** (waste-pickers' ~15-40 lakh workforce — 'recognise, don't replace')

items: **SWM's binding constraint is behavioural-institutional, not technical**: segregation at source decides everything downstream (mixed waste kills composting and WtE alike); **Indore's** decade-topping SBM run proves the model — door-to-door six-way segregation, GPS fleets, processing at scale, user-fee discipline: cite it as the existence proof.
**Waste-to-energy's honest note**: works only on segregated high-CV residuals; as mixed-waste incineration it's costly and dirty — 'WtE is a residuals technology, not a substitute for segregation'.

**Circular pivot**: EPR's producer financing + recyclate standards + design-for-recycling (the plastic ban's single-use list) + urban mining (e-waste's metals) — waste policy graduating into materials policy.

**AP file**: Vizag-Tirupati-Vijayawada's Swachh rankings runs, **Anantapur-era garbage-free-city pilots**, secretariat-linked collection (~100% door-to-door claims), legacy-dump bioremediation at the big-city sites, aqua-processing waste and coastal plastic (the fishing-net EPR frontier) — plus the **Tirupati temple-town model** (banned plastics, mass composting of floral waste) as a religious-city showcase.

sections.heading: 🔬 Deep mastery — noise, the neglected pollutant

items: **Measurement:** in **decibels (dB, logarithmic scale)**; the **Noise Pollution (Regulation & Control) Rules 2000** set limits — industrial 75/70, commercial 65/55, residential 55/45, silence zones 50/40 dB (day/night).
**Health effects:** hearing loss, hypertension, sleep disturbance, cognitive impairment in children, and stress — a WHO-recognised environmental health risk.

**Sources & control:** traffic, industry, construction, loudspeakers/firecrackers; controls — silence zones (near hospitals/schools), acoustic barriers, engine mufflers, and judicial limits on festival loudspeakers.
**Craft:** flag noise as an under-regulated pollutant with real morbidity — a fresh angle in a pollution answer.

prelimsPointers: **Noise Pollution (Regulation and Control) Rules, 2000** — under the Environment (Protection) Act 1986.
Silence zones (near hospitals/educational institutions): **50 dB (day) / 40 dB (night)**.
**Decibel scale is logarithmic**: +10 dB = tenfold intensity; chronic **>85 dB** risks noise-induced hearing loss.
**Noise Rules 2000** zones (day/night dB): industrial **75/70**, commercial **65/55**, residential **55/45**, **silence 50/40**; loudspeakers barred **10 pm-6 am** (SC 2005).
**SWM Rules 2016**: source segregation (wet/dry/domestic-hazardous), decentralised processing, landfills for residuals only.
India's MSW ~**62+ million tonnes/yr**; legacy dumpsites ~3,000+; **SBM-Urban 2.0** targets full remediation ('lakshya zero dumpsites').
**EPR rules family**: plastic packaging (2022 targets), e-waste (2022), batteries (2022), tyres — producer-financed circularity.
**Indore** — India's cleanest city for successive Swachh surveys: the segregation-processing model city.
**GOBARdhan/CBG** links wet waste to bio-energy; C&D waste rules (2016) mandate recycling plants.
Informal waste workforce ~**15-40 lakh**; integration (not displacement) is stated policy.
mainsAngles: Noise is the pollutant without a lobby — assess its health file and the enforcement gap in the 2000 Rules.
Segregation decides everything — anatomise the SWM 2016 architecture and Indore's existence proof.
Waste-to-energy is a residuals technology — evaluate its Indian record against the composting-first logic.
EPR turns waste policy into materials policy — examine the producer-responsibility regimes and their markets.
Integrate, don't replace — argue the informal sector's place in India's recycling economy.

glossary.definition: A-weighted decibel — sound intensity weighted to human hearing; the logarithmic unit of noise regulation.
100-m belts around hospitals, schools and courts with the strictest limits (50/40 dB) under the 2000 Rules.
Household separation of wet, dry and hazardous streams — the hinge of all downstream waste processing.
Sorting plant channelling dry waste to recyclers — the dry stream's processing node.
Decades-old dumped mixed waste; bio-mined and remediated under SBM 2.0's zero-dumpsite goal.
Producers' financed obligation for post-consumer product waste — plastics-e-waste-battery rules' engine.

sections.heading: Soil erosion — the quiet haemorrhage and its remedies

blocks.text: India loses soil at ~**15-16 tonnes/ha/yr average (~5+ billion tonnes)** against a tolerable ~4-11; **water erosion dominates (~80%+ of degraded area)** — sheet → rill → gully progression — with wind erosion in the arid west. Drivers: vegetation loss, up-down cultivation on slopes, overgrazing, fallow exposure to monsoon bursts, and construction's cut-and-dump. **The remedy stack is the watershed toolkit applied by slope class**: **agronomic** (contour cultivation, strip cropping, cover crops-mulching, conservation tillage/zero-till, grass waterways), **mechanical** (contour bunding, graded bunds, **bench terracing** for >15-20% slopes, trenches, gully control — check dams, spurs), **vegetative** (shelterbelts-windbreaks for wind erosion, vetiver hedgerows — the 'living bund', afforestation of ridges, dune stabilisation with grasses), **regulatory** (grazing rotation, mining-construction sediment control) — matched, sequenced (ridge-to-valley), and community-maintained (the Hiware-Bazar lesson from ED-046).

rows: The problem

**~34% of India's coastline is eroding** (NCCR shoreline atlas); drivers — sediment starvation (upstream dams trapping silt: the Krishna-Godavari deltas' deficit), **ports-breakwaters interrupting longshore drift** (the classic updrift-accretion/downdrift-erosion couple), sand mining, mangrove loss, SLR + intensified cyclones
**AP's hotspots**

**Uppada (Kakinada coast)** — the state's emblematic eroding village (highway-homes lost; geo-tube trials), Kakinada-Godavari spit dynamics, **Visakhapatnam's post-port erosion history (RK Beach nourishment via dredger bypassing)**, Krishna delta's retreat (Diviseema shores), Nizampatnam sector — the state's shoreline audit shows significant eroding stretches
Hard responses

Seawalls-revetments (protect land, often transfer erosion downdrift & lose the beach), **groynes** (trap drift — starve neighbours), offshore breakwaters — engineering with side-effects: 'armouring is local victory, coastal defeat' unless system-designed
Soft & hybrid responses

**Beach nourishment + sediment bypassing at ports (Vizag's practice)**, dune rebuilding, **mangrove-shelterbelt bio-shields** (post-2004 evidence; Coringa's buffer), **geo-textile tubes/reef units (Uppada trials, Kerala's Poonthura-era pilots)**, managed retreat + setback enforcement (**CRZ 2019's hazard-line logic**) — working WITH the sediment budget

items: **One science, two theatres**: both erosions are **sediment-budget problems** — soil erosion exports the farm's capital; coastal erosion is the shore's account running deficits (dams withhold deposits, structures divert transfers) — the budget metaphor unifies the answer.

**Choose interventions by process, not fashion**: agronomy before masonry on farms (cheapest first); nourishment-bypassing before armour on coasts; and always the maintenance-institution question (bunds silt, geo-tubes tear — who repairs?).

**Policy anchors**: watershed programmes (PMKSY-WDC, MGNREGA-NRM) for soil; **NCCR shoreline monitoring, CRZ-2019 hazard mapping, the National Strategy for Coastal Protection & flood-plain-esque setback discipline** for coasts; climate adaptation funds converging on both.

**AP close**: a delta state with dam-starved sediment and a port-dense coast is erosion's natural laboratory — Uppada's geo-tubes, Vizag's bypassing, Coringa's mangroves and the ridge-to-valley uplands give AP one example per technique.

sections.heading: 🔬 Deep mastery — soil erosion, the quiet haemorrhage

items: **Types & drivers:** water erosion (sheet, rill, gully — the ravines of the Chambal), wind erosion (arid west), and mass movement; accelerated by deforestation, over-grazing, faulty tillage and shifting cultivation.
**Scale:** India loses billions of tonnes of topsoil a year; erosion strips nutrients, silts reservoirs, and drives desertification.
**Remedies (agronomic + mechanical):** contour bunding, terracing, strip cropping, cover crops, agroforestry/shelterbelts, check dams, gully plugging, and watershed management (ridge-to-valley).
**Policy:** the **National Watershed Development Project, PMKSY watershed component, and CAMPA afforestation** — soil conservation as climate adaptation.

prelimsPointers: **Gully erosion** produces the ravine/badland topography of the Chambal valley.
**Shelterbelts** — rows of trees planted to reduce wind erosion in arid regions.
mainsAngles: 'Soil erosion is a silent threat to India's food security' — examine its causes and the conservation response.

prelimsPointers: India's soil loss ~**15.35 t/ha/yr** (~5.3 billion tonnes); **water erosion ~80%+** of degraded area; progression **sheet→rill→gully**.
**Bench terracing** suits steep (>16%) slopes; contour bunding gentler ones; **vetiver hedgerows** the vegetative bund.
**~33-34% of India's coastline is eroding** (NCCR National Shoreline Assessment).
**Longshore drift interruption** by ports/groynes → updrift accretion, **downdrift erosion** — the coastal-structure signature.
**Uppada (Kakinada)** — AP's flagship erosion village; **geo-textile tube** protection trials; Vizag practises **sand bypassing/beach nourishment**.
Upstream **dams trap sediment**, starving deltas (Krishna-Godavari) — subsidence-plus-SLR compounds retreat.
**Mangrove bio-shields** attenuate waves/surge (post-2004 tsunami evidence); **Coringa** is AP's buffer forest.
**CRZ Notification 2019** + hazard-line mapping govern coastal setbacks.
mainsAngles: Erosion is a sediment-budget deficit — unify the farm and the shore under one science and derive matched remedies.
Agronomy before masonry — sequence the soil-conservation stack by slope and cost with programme anchors.
Ports build beaches on one side and eat villages on the other — explain the drift mechanics and the bypassing answer.
Hard armour or soft adaptation — adjudicate coastal-protection choices with AP's Uppada-Vizag-Coringa evidence.
Dams starve deltas — connect reservoir siltation to coastal retreat and the governance it demands.

glossary.definition: Water erosion's escalation from uniform skimming to channels to ravines — the diagnostic sequence.
Converting steep slopes into level steps — the mechanical answer where bunds can't hold.
Wave-driven along-coast sediment conveyor — interrupting it redistributes beaches from downdrift to updrift.
Artificially replenishing beach sand (often by port dredger bypassing) — protection that keeps the beach.
Sand-filled fabric barriers used as soft-engineered coastal defence — Uppada's trial technology.
Deficit of river-borne sediment (dam-trapped) that turns stable deltas into retreating ones.
